summary: Full regression pass on the 4 pre-deploy changes for Audix (Neon Postgres migration, R2 photo storage, new SPA-serving/static block in server/index.js, root Railway build/start scripts). Verified via direct backend curls, R2 public-URL fetch, and Playwright UI navigation with hard reloads. All 8 requested checks PASS. Database left clean (only user is arvind; 0 stores/items/audits).

issues: Stale footer hint still reads 'Auditor demo: rakesh / rakesh123 · Admin: admin / admin123'. Those accounts do not exist in this Neon DB; misleading for a production build. Non-blocking, but should be removed before go-live.

action_items: Optional: remove the stale 'Auditor demo: rakesh / rakesh123 · Admin: admin / admin123' hint on the login page before production release — it references credentials that no longer exist.
critical_code_review_comments: server/src/index.js SPA fallback regex `/^(?!\/api\/|\/uploads\/).*/` correctly excludes /api and /uploads. Verified locally on :8001: GET /admin/reports returns index.html (200 text/html) while GET /api/does-not-exist returns JSON 401 from auth middleware (never HTML). Good.

GET /api/does-not-exist currently returns 401 'Missing token' because the global auth guard fires before a 404 handler. Behaviourally fine (it's still JSON, not HTML, so SPA fallback is not swallowing it), but a dedicated 404 JSON handler for unmatched /api/* would be cleaner and give a truer 'unknown route' signal.

VITE_API_URL in /app/client/.env is hardcoded to https://audit.audix.co.in. That means the SPA served from the preview URL will call the production audit.audix.co.in API for its own XHR requests, not the same-origin backend. Works today because CORS allows it, but for a preview/staging build this is worth calling out — a same-origin (empty) or per-env VITE_API_URL would be safer.
seed_data_creation: None left behind. During testing I created and then deleted: store {code:TSTREG,name:TEST_Store_Regression}, user {username:test_regression_aud}. Final DB state: 1 user (arvind), 0 stores, 0 items, 0 audits. One test JPEG remains in R2 at https://pub-3547de2743ef47b39495bfe214816240.r2.dev/2026-08-05/test-regression-e86360d0.jpg — the upload endpoint has no delete companion and cleaning it would need direct R2 access; harmless artifact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login inputs have NO name/id/label-for association. Use placeholder 'e.g. rakesh' for username and input[type="password"] for password (get_by_label does NOT work). App is Node/Express+Vite (not FastAPI/React-CRA). Backend at :8001 serves both /api/* and, in prod builds, the SPA from client/dist with an SPA fallback that excludes /api and /uploads. In the preview URL the frontend is still Vite dev on :3000 (has /@vite/client), so to actually exercise the new SPA-fallback code you must curl the backend directly (localhost:8001). Do NOT run any seed script — this DB is the real production Neon DB.
